digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions CI / test.yml golden-path gate
propositions: test.yml golden-path job runs check_readme_quickstart.py and probe_rebar.py without predates-gate guards, while the verified lane (gerrit-verify.yaml) has them, causing mirror lane failures when base predates the scripts
Adding canonical [ ! -f <path> ] guards to both golden-path steps with canonical skip message aligns test.yml with gerrit-verify.yaml guard parity
Removing predates-gate-ok markers from test_predates_gate_guard_parity.py after guards are in place ensures completeness validation passes
Guarded steps must exit 0 and print canonical skip message in empty directory
test_golden_path_guards_match_the_verified_lane parity test enforces that every step running either script in either CI lane carries its own -f guard with canonical message
